pair_cache_contract: No-BRIDGE FINAL reuses the full pair cache of the final accepted HINGE/ALPHA geometry, or the unchanged BASE cache. Each accepted geometric proposal is checked with the original full detector; identical ALPHA geometries may use exact cache hits. BRIDGE FINAL is independently fully scanned and compared with the incremental cache. BASE score expansions reuse complete pair caches; new BASE pair caches are scanned once.
additional_notes: Topology and extras are read-only derivations, not additional metric-score cells. The two failed engineering partials are preserved; concurrency drain caused no cell replay. I uses fixed C queries and is not certified nonincreasing by the finite-pair guard.
